title: frustrated-spin: continuous exact joint densities through N1800 and milestones through N5000
description:
Continuous exact g(E,M,b) through N1800:10,800structured graph/fill cases, original compact records, equations, bound source code and checksums. Isolated full-output packages extend to N5000. Compact evidence and expanded coefficients have explicit separate data scopes.

Exact N2000 g(E,M,b) for six structured complete Ising graphs, all 16 boundary states, 244,104,392 primary records.

Licensing: project-owned software is MIT; research datasets, receipts, manuscript/report prose and figures are CC BY 4.0. LICENSING.md defines the scope, including the checksum-identified public Drive data and RUNTIME_LICENSE.md grants for frozen runtime copies. Third-party licenses are preserved. This additional grant supersedes inherited research-only restrictions for the scoped project-owned spin materials.

Sean Brady: originator and conceptual director. OpenAI ChatGPT and Codex: AI research collaborators. CITATION.cff requests the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22989862.
